The '''Firefight at the Blue Star casino''' was a skirmish between [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and several forces under the command of the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]], who were attempting to claim a one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bounty on Solo

==Background==
In [[45 ABY]], the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] were attempting to arrest financial control of the lucrative [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. However, they came into conflict with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who refused to sell his holdings in the rift. Determined to drive Calrissian away, the Qrephs attempted to kill Calrissian and his companions, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Although the Qrephs organized the [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|destruction]] of Calrissian's [[Sarnus Refinery|refinery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]], they failed to kill their targets.<ref name="C" /> To escape, Calrissian and the Solos made their way to Valnoos on the recommendation of Calrissian's associate, [[Dena Yus]], who was a secret agent of the Qrephs. The group headed to the Blue Star casino, unawares that it had been recently purchased by the Qrephs who were ready for their arrival. To ensure at least the capture of Solo, the Qrephs had also placed a one million credit bounty on Solo<ref name="C" />

==The skirmish==
As Calrissian and Solo gambled in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] variant game known as [[Riftwalker/Legends|riftwalker]], Leia Organa Solo and Luke Skywalker, disguised as a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] respectively, watched from afar. With Solo and Calrissian right where they wanted them, the Qrephs' agents moved in. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], [[Mirta Gev]], flanked by several Mandalorian troopers entered the casino, and Mirta joined the sabacc game, hoping to get Solo to come with her peacefully. Solo, hoping that his wife and his brother-in-law would rescue him before Gev could take him offworld, agreed to go peacefully. However, as Gev was taking him into custody, [[Omad Kaeg]], an associate of Calrissian, refused to let Solo be captured. He opened fire on the Mandalorians and the Blue Star security personnel, triggering a firefight. As blasterbolts flew across the casino, Solo attacked Dena Yus, who he had realized was a spy. In the struggle, Solo opened her purse to reveal several [[arachnokiller]]s. As the creatures scattered, they began to explode in the casino, throwing the area into disarray. In the confusion, Gev grabbed Solo and made her escape.<ref name="C" />

As Solo was about to be dragged into a [[Tra'kad-class transport|''Tra'kad'']] shuttle, Skywalker and Organa Solo broke into the hangar with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Mandalorian troopers attempted to stop the Jedi, but they were soundly defeated, and it appeared that Gev would be unable to escape. However, the Qrephs' [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] agent, [[Vestara Khai]], used her abilities to distract the Jedi, throwing grenades at their feet. Unable to focus on Gev, the Mandalorian pulled Solo aboard her shuttle and departed Valnoos. However, the Jedi were able to throw a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on the ship beore it could escape.<ref name="C" />

==Aftermath==
Upon her departure, Gev brought Solo to the Qrephs on their [[asteroid crusher]], the ''[[Ormni]]''. However, she was unable to collect the entire one million credit bounty due to Vestara Khai's claim that she had been responsible for Gev escaping. The argument was interrupted by the arrival of the Jedi in a [[ScragHull commando boat]] who had come to [[Ambush at the Ormni|rescue]] Solo.<ref name="C" />
